game.name: Calculator
game.desc:
Full-featured calculator application with basic arithmetic operations (+, -, ×, ÷), decimal point support, and 16-digit precision. Features include Clear (C), All Clear (AC), and Delete functions. Optimized for 720x480 resolution with color-coded buttons for easy navigation.
Controls: - D-Pad: Navigate between calculator buttons - A Button: Press the selected button - B/Start/Select: Exit calculator
